final: WITH per_telescope AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS pulse_avg FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), per_status AS (SELECT t.equipstatus, AVG(p.pulse_avg) AS pulse_avg FROM per_telescope AS p JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.telescregistry = p.telescref GROUP BY t.equipstatus), above_overall AS (SELECT equipstatus, pulse_avg, pulse_avg - (SELECT AVG(pulse_avg) FROM per_status) AS difference FROM per_status WHERE pulse_avg > (SELECT AVG(pulse_avg) FROM per_status)), above_selected AS (SELECT equipstatus, pulse_avg, difference, pulse_avg - (SELECT AVG(pulse_avg) FROM above_overall) AS second_difference FROM above_overall WHERE pulse_avg > (SELECT AVG(pulse_avg) FROM above_overall)) SELECT AVG(pulse_avg), AVG(difference), AVG(second_difference) FROM above_selected
